description: Tools the User Assistant uses to review accounts, communicate with members, and perform approved account-security actions

lock_user_account.reason: Blocks a user from signing in

force_password_reset.reason: Forces a user to reset their password

manage_user_privileges.reason: Reading the current privilege/limit picture is always safe. Granting or revoking a plugin/agent privilege is a meaningful trust decision (high); adjusting a daily usage limit is low-risk throttling; allowing anonymous chat exposes a surface to visitors who aren't logged in (medium).
